CHAP. 52.—An Act For the extension of Franklin street northeast from its
present eastern terminus east of Twenty-fourth street to the Bladensburg road.
Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United
District of Columbia.
Franklin    street
northeast.

east of Twenty-fourth street to the Bladensburg road, according to the
